facades.name: NW slab street end (Apollolaan)
facades.note: The 12.5 m end wall: one narrow stair window per level in a vertical strip 7.6-8.2 m from the viewer-left (north-east) corner, seven levels from the street to the top storey; the HARBOUR CLUB and LIVING ROOM boards, APOLLO HOTEL and the red A are applied, not openings. The crop stops short of the set-back 6.8 m wall to the right (w13).

facades.name: Boeken pavilion canal front
facades.note: Ground storey: five window bays 2.1-18.2 m under the gallery, then solid white wall with two portholes (applied discs, not openings); upper storey: one continuous glazed band behind the gallery rail. Columns: the five bay axes plus the band's own axis.
